description.text: The eighth Sword & Shield set, released on 12 November 2021 with 284 cards: 264 and 20 secret rares. It brought in a third battle style, Fusion Strike, with more than 20 cards such as Mew VMAX, Genesect V and Hoopa V, while Single Strike and Rapid Strike continue with Gigantamax Rillaboom, Cinderace and Inteleon VMAX. It has 20 Pokémon V and eight Pokémon VMAX.
